note: Port of public/forms/casedetails-bk.html (formKey case_details). 45 existing submissions. Layout loss: the .yc-section-pair side-by-side pairs (Fee Agreements|Credit Counseling, Matrix|Schedules) become stacked sections — the schema has no section-pair concept. 2.5B: trustee options/derived dates/client names moved into the definition; hook shrunk to case_details_bk2 (341-link on trustee change + docket split + chapter mirror).

fields.label: Co-Debtor

fields.name: case_number
fields.note: GAP: the hand-built form splits one typed docket into case_number (short) + case_number_full (full) in _buildPatchPayload. apiColumn is 1:1, so the hook re-installs that split by wrapping _buildPatchPayload. apiColumn stays case_number_full for the LOAD direction (matches the original apiMap).
fields.label: Case Number

fields.name: case_chapter
fields.note: GAP: also mirrors to cases.case_subtype ("Chapter 7") in the same wrapped _buildPatchPayload.
fields.label: Chapter

fields.name: case_trustee
fields.note: Static options are the fallback snapshot; optionsFrom (2.5B) rebuilds them at load from firmData.settings.trustees, grouped by chapter, with the flagged-unlisted-value behaviour. The 341-link write on trustee CHANGE stays in the hook (case_details_bk2).
fields.label: Trustee

fields.name: case_341_link
fields.note: Written by the hook when the user changes trustee (trustee.link from firmData.settings.trustees). Read by the appointment automation (T19) as the 341 meeting link.
